description:
FILED s473t5a (#1501 CHECK 1 round 2, 2026-09-13).  The SECOND of the two
refusals behind t/op/decl-refs.t's 195 rows (#1648 is the first).

MINIMAL REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 runs it; PCL refuses):

    use feature 'declared_refs', 'refaliasing';
    no warnings 'experimental::declared_refs';
    no warnings 'experimental::refaliasing';
    our $y = 5;
    for my \$x (\$main::y) { print "in loop x=$x\n" }

    perl: in loop x=5
    pcl : Parser2 TODO: foreach without list at Pl/Parser2.pm line 10520

IT IS A PPI BUG, not a PCL one.  PPI 1.291 LEXES the file (the document is not
undef, unlike #1580's shape) but structures it wrongly -- the `for` compound
keeps only its two Words and everything else becomes a sibling statement:

    PPI::Document
      PPI::Statement::Compound
        PPI::Token::Word     'for'
        PPI::Token::Word     'my'
      PPI::Statement
        PPI::Token::Cast     '\'
        PPI::Token::Symbol   '$x'
        PPI::Structure::List     ( ... )
          PPI::Statement::Expression
            PPI::Token::Cast     '\'
            PPI::Token::Symbol   '$main::y'
        PPI::Structure::Block    { ... }
          ...

Expected: ONE `PPI::Statement::Compound` holding the Word `for`, the Word `my`,
the declared-ref loop variable, the List and the Block.  PCL's
`_lower_compound` then finds no `PPI::Structure::List` among the Compound's
children and dies.

SAME PPI DEFECT AS #1580 / ppi-upstream-bugs.md section 29, one step milder:
PPI's `for`-compound lexer accepts a plain Symbol (`for $x (…)`) or `my` plus a
plain Symbol, and nothing else.  A DEREFERENCE as the loop variable
(`for $$f (…)`, section 29) fails the lexer outright; a DECLARED REF
(`for my \$x (…)`) merely falls out of the compound.  Logged as section 29's
addendum with a row in docs/ppi-bug-report.t (s473t5a, same commit as this
filing).

WHAT PCL OWES BEYOND THE PPI FIX: `for my \$x (LIST)` is refaliasing -- each
iteration binds `$x` as an ALIAS of the list element's referent.  PCL
implements refaliasing (#325), but `_lower_compound`'s foreach arm reads the
loop variable as a `PPI::Token::Symbol` and would need the declared-ref
spelling.  So this is two pieces, and the PPI half is upstream's.

SIZE: 195 rows of t/op/decl-refs.t, shared with #1648 -- nine of the file's 21
eval'd programs (the whole second heredoc, `for MY \~x (\~::y) {…}` x 3
declarators x 3 sigils) carry this shape and NOTHING else, so they are blocked
on this alone.
subject: PPI 1.291 mis-lexes a DECLARED-REF foreach loop variable -- `for my \$x (\$y) {}` builds Compound('for my') plus a SEPARATE Statement, so PCL says "Parser2 TODO: foreach without list"; t/op/decl-refs.t
